poc.title: $t(common:term.xlog) canvas proof of concept
poc.description: Synthetic transactions generated in the browser. No server is involved.

empty.title: No transactions in the selected range.
empty.description: Widen the range or check the filters and the kind.
empty.impossible: The filters cannot match any transaction. Clear them or check their values.

rangeLimit.title: The XLog shows at most {{hours, number}} hours at a time.
rangeLimit.description: Choose a shorter range to load the points.

live.fillError: The data of the gap could not be loaded. Resume again to retry.
live.polling: No realtime updates: loading the points from the server every {{seconds, number}} s.

table.caption: Transactions per time interval and status

keyboard.instructions: Arrow keys move a time band, Shift with the arrow keys resizes it, Home and End move it to the start or the end, Enter selects its transactions, Escape cancels.
keyboard.band: Band from {{from}} to {{to}}. Press Enter to select it.
keyboard.noBand: No band yet. Press an arrow key to start one.

canvas.label_one: $t(common:term.xlog): response time of {{count, number}} transaction over time
canvas.label_other: $t(common:term.xlog): response time of {{count, number}} transactions over time

summary.title: Selection summary
summary.empty: Drag across the chart to select transactions. Their summary and list appear here.
summary.sampled: Based on the points shown: the data is sampled.
summary.filterHint: Select a row to filter the list.
summary.emptyKeyboard: Drag across the chart to select transactions, or focus the chart and select a region with the keyboard. Their summary and list appear here.
summary.serverCount_one: {{count, number}} transaction in the region on the server
summary.serverCount_other: {{count, number}} transactions in the region on the server
summary.rowFilterHint: Select a row to filter the chart and the list by it; select it again to remove the filter. The selection stays.
summary.unapplied: Not applied to the chart and this summary:

source.clientHint: Counted in the browser from the points drawn in the chart.
source.serverHint: Counted by the server over every transaction in the region, also the ones the chart does not draw.

errors.title: By error class
errors.unavailable: The points carry no error class. Check the list.

list.title: Selected transactions
list.empty: No transaction in the selection matches the filter. Clear the filter to see all of them.
list.caption: Transactions of the selected region
list.noSelection: Drag across the chart, or select a region with the keyboard, to list its transactions.

noMatch.title: No transaction in the selected region.
noMatch.description: Widen the selection or check the filters and the kind.
noMatch.impossible: The filters cannot match any transaction: check the values listed above.

list.userNotCollected: User IDs are not collected for this application, so the user ID column is hidden.
list.preview: Preview from the chart's points. Loading the list from the server…
list.filterLimit: A link holds at most {{max, number}} filters: remove one before adding another.

csvError.limit: The export has more than 10,000 rows. Narrow the selection or the filters.
csvError.rateLimited: Too many exports. Try again in {{seconds, number}} s.
